summary: Iteration 24 verification of org affiliation, pending ratings page, region persistence, and multicrew stepper. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration24_features.py with 11 tests - all 11 passing against production preview URL. Frontend verified via Playwright: all documented data-testid elements render correctly on /ratings, /orgs, /orgs/:id, /profile, /settings, and /contracts. Multi-crew stepper (steps 0-3) wires up properly, job cards display '[MTO]' org tag next to reputation and 'X/N SEATS FILLED - OPEN: <roles>' as specified. Backend derives per-seat payout correctly (floor(90000/3)=30000). Region prompt does NOT re-appear for users with region persisted on account (confirmed region='Global' in /auth/me response).

minor.issue: Returns 200 with {count:0,items:[]} for unauthenticated callers instead of 401/403. No data leak (empty payload) but inconsistent with REST norms. Matches pattern of other optional-auth endpoints in server.py.

Backend ignores `crew_roles` alone - requires client to also pre-build the `manifest` list with per-seat payouts. Fine for current frontend (useCreateContract.js does this) but means an API consumer who sends only crew_roles+payment_amount gets a solo contract with empty manifest.

issues: When MULTI-CREW toggle is ON, modal heading becomes 'Post Multi-Crew Job' and shows stepper; this is correct behaviour but step 1 fields (title/description/timing/duration/multi-crew toggle) are nearly identical to solo form, which may confuse testers checking 'is stepper active'. Not a bug - just note for future tests.

action_items: (Optional/low-pri) Make /api/ratings/pending return 401 for unauth instead of empty 200 for better REST hygiene.
(Optional) Consider deriving manifest server-side from crew_roles + payment_amount so API consumers only need to send intent.
critical_code_review_comments: ratings_queue.create_obligations also writes a 'completed' obligation row when a side has already rated - these never appear in /ratings/pending (filtered by status=pending) but do add DB rows; worth confirming intent (audit trail vs noise).

affiliation.enrich_org_tags does a single org_tag_map lookup per contracts batch (good); verified /api/contracts response includes `poster.org_tag` and `poster.org_id` when the poster has an affiliation.
server.py line ~4898 /ratings/pending: `if not user: return {...}` pattern silently masks auth failure - acceptable but worth logging a warning so prod misconfigurations are caught.

Admin's affiliation was mutated by tests (now set to MTO). Baseline before run was None; cleanup leaves it ON MTO so the UI tests can assert the tag. If a future test needs admin without affiliation, it must reset first.

rca of the issue: No blocking issues found. Minor: /api/ratings/pending returning 200 for unauth is a stylistic choice already present across the codebase (/api/user/accepted-bids etc.) - endpoint checks `if not user: return <empty>` instead of relying on get_current_user to raise. Fix would be to make get_current_user require auth by default and have endpoints opt-in to optional auth.
